issue.title: Recent-window short-circuit drops live successors from ACE-run continuation planning
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `src/sase/core/agent_artifact_run_retention_candidates.py` (`collect_ace_run_retention_candidates`; introduced in `92dc6274e5` as the keep-recent short-circuit in `agent_artifact_run_retention.py`)

`test_plan_protects_live_continuation_ancestry_from_audit_probe` fails because continuation planning is called only with out-of-window dirs. A live successor in the keep-recent window (`202609…`, `keep_recent_months=2`) is omitted, so the older ancestor (`202605…`) is selected instead of protected with `continuation_ancestry`.

The sibling tests that keep both runs out of window (`test_plan_protects_pending_delivery_ancestry`) still pass. Record scan short-circuit for recent dirs can stay; continuation planning still needs the recent live run in the graph.

Reproduced on the pre-split monolith (`git checkout HEAD -- src/sase/core/agent_artifact_run_retention.py`) and after the split. `sase tool run check` run `f3d3931dc0a26143ace1ff5687717330` labeled it NEW.

## Repro

```bash
.venv/bin/pytest tests/core/test_continuation_retention.py::test_plan_protects_live_continuation_ancestry_from_audit_probe -q
```

## Impact

ACE-run retention preview can select an old ancestor while a live recent successor still points at it. Apply already refuses mutation, but preview/quarantine review can list a run that must stay.
